events.title: MetaMask browser wallet released
events.summary: ConsenSys released MetaMask in July 2016 — a browser extension that injected an Ethereum wallet and `web3` provider into every webpage.
events.about: MetaMask let users sign transactions without running a full node and gave dapps a standard `window.ethereum` [API]. It became the default wallet for [DeFi], [NFT] mints, and testnets — the on-ramp that turned Web3 from [CLI] tools into click-to-sign UX.

narrative.whyChosen: MetaMask made Ethereum usable from a normal browser tab.
narrative.whyImportant: It standardized how web apps request signatures and read chain state.
narrative.problemSolved: Early dapps required command-line clients; mainstream users needed a simple signing surface.
